profile.name: North Bend

resources.label: Village right-of-way application — separate from sign approval
Village-linked zoning code — current amendments unverified

document_findings.label: Printed adoption statement
document_findings.text: The cover states adoption April 28, 2025. Later amendments and current compilation remain unverified.

document_findings.label: Permit trigger and exemptions
document_findings.text: Part 4.B starts with a zoning-permit trigger and enumerated exemptions. An exemption must be checked against its conditions and the proposed sign; it does not establish a building or electrical exemption.
document_findings.matched_text: a Zoning Permit shall be obtained

document_findings.label: Freestanding signs
document_findings.text: The retained page includes district-specific freestanding tables, per-face accounting, base and landscaping provisions, and a pole-sign restriction. Use the original table for review; no district or numeric allowance is approved for a job.

document_findings.label: Wall sign district table
document_findings.text: The wall-sign table varies by district, frontage and building width; PUD provisions refer to an approved development plan. Page-linked table remains unreviewed for current applicability.

document_findings.label: Window, wayfinding and sign lighting
document_findings.text: The page includes window coverage, wayfinding, entrance-wall and drive-through provisions, then begins sign lighting. Lighting continues on the next page; a cross-reference printed as B.13.a requires review against the section numbering.

document_findings.label: Lighting and temporary signs
document_findings.text: The retained text includes a 4,000K lighting limit and temporary-sign rules with different small/large permit triggers, district restrictions and duration provisions. These are document candidates; zoning lighting conditions do not identify an electrical permit issuer or inspector.

document_findings.label: Electronic displays and murals
document_findings.text: The page contains message timing, transition and auto-dimming provisions plus mural permits. Review sign type and district before applying these provisions.

document_findings.label: Billboard certificates and state permits
document_findings.text: The billboard section describes a sign zoning certificate and a possible state transportation permit in addition to local review. Routine-maintenance language here does not establish an electrical-permit exemption.

notes: The Village zoning page identifies Hamilton County zoning assistance and county building-permit issuance. Office identity, current responsibility and job-address coverage still require approval.

The reviewed Village forms page links a right-of-way application. This form does not replace sign zoning or building approval. A separate sign application/online submission route was not located on that page.
The county zoning page and 2024 zoning application originals returned HTTP 403. They remain retention gaps.
Electrical permit issuance and electrical inspection remain independently unresolved. Sign-lighting standards do not establish either office.

The county digital-permitting reference describes ezTrak with partner-agency paper exceptions. Its original HTML download is blocked (HTTP 403); North Bend sign-specific portal applicability remains unconfirmed. This reference does not resolve electrical permit issuance or inspection.

references.label: County digital permitting reference — original retention gap; sign route unconfirmed

profile.extraction_note: Embedded text was extracted across 181 code pages and two right-of-way pages. Page findings remain pending review; extraction does not verify tables, current amendments or complete searchable content.
